integrity: All derivations and finite verification inputs are included; finite computation does not replace the infinite proof. No independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on an escaping orbit of either signed quadratic map. The universal lower bound is not claimed optimal; no upper growth bound or symmetric-map analogue is established. The conclusion is deduced from published odd-return identities, and implicit antecedents remain possible.
title: Prime-support rigidity and stretched-exponential escape for two quadratic Collatz maps
